notes: FIX App could freeze or stay hung in the background - it now recovers by itself, closes fully when you quit, and a frozen copy can no longer block a new launch
FIX Background tasks can no longer hang the window; the installer is now a normal folder install (starts faster, no second background process)
FIX Simpler updates: the SHA-256 check was removed
NEW Update Control: block Windows Update for 7, 14 or 30 days (or until you unblock) and turn it back on any time - safe while Windows is installing
NEW Lite Mode: turn Windows lite for speed with Normal, Aggressive, Extreme and Ultra Fast levels - every tweak is separate and can be reverted exactly
Every change remembers the original setting, so undo puts things back as they were
Loading indicators no longer cover the screen, and background work never freezes the window
New shortcuts: Ctrl+U for Update Control, F9 for Lite Mode
